Brace yourself, Libra – the cosmos is about to swing a massive seesaw in your relationships this week!

Monday brings Venus trine your 7th House, igniting love, and as an Air sign you savor the mental spark.

Wednesday powers up as Mercury kisses Jupiter in your 2nd House for money while Venus slips into your 5th House, sparking romance.

Thursday marks a pivotal shift as Chiron squares your natal Venus, prompting deep emotional healing.

Friday sees Jupiter sextile your 10th House, boosting career recognition.

Saturday and Sunday watch Mercury station direct in your 12th House, urging quiet financial planning.

Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, delivering peak romance.

Tuesday is your caution day as Mars squares your 10th House, stirring authority clashes.

Plan a romantic dinner Wednesday and schedule that career conversation Friday for optimal results.

Follow for daily updates.
